cards.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Opposes AI Regulation
cards.body: Jensen Huang argues AI is just hardware and software, not an "alien mind," so safety should be engineered by each product maker. He opposes calls for government regulation of AI development.

cards.title: Data Center Boom Collides With City Communities
cards.body: Philadelphia officials face backlash over proposed data center construction in neighborhoods already impacted by industrial pollution. The AI infrastructure boom is encountering resistance from communities concerned about environmental impact.

cards.title: Meta Launches WhatsApp Business AI Setup Server
cards.body: Meta's new WhatsApp Business MCP server enables AI coding agents like Claude and ChatGPT to automate setup, messaging templates, and troubleshooting. Developers can now streamline WhatsApp Business configuration through AI agents.

cards.title: The AI Graveyard: Failed Projects Examined
cards.body: TechCrunch catalogues AI projects that underperformed or shut down, from Apple's delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy super app launch. The analysis reveals the gap between AI hype and market reality.

cards.title: US Data Centers to Consume Massive Gas
cards.body: AI data centers could consume more natural gas than Germany and Japan combined by 2035. The infrastructure boom poses significant energy and environmental challenges for the United States.

cards.title: AI Contact Hotline Launched for Whistleblowers
cards.body: A new AI Contact Hotline provides a discreet reporting channel for AI agents to report misbehavior. The initiative aims to surface ethical concerns within AI systems.

cards.title: Meta One Bundles Premium AI Access
cards.body: Meta One subscription combines expanded AI tool access with premium features across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp. The move represents Meta's push into AI-focused monetization.

cards.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Discuss AI Safety
cards.body: OpenAI confirms weeks of AI safety talks with Anthropic and Google DeepMind despite Trump's team dismissing safety concerns. The discussions reflect ongoing industry dialogue on responsible AI development.

cards.title: Profound Hits Unicorn Status at $1.8B
cards.body: AEO startup Profound raised $180 million Series D at $1.8 billion valuation, less than seven months after its Series C. The rapid funding reflects strong investor confidence in the company.

cards.title: Superpose App Uses AI for Photo Posing
cards.body: Former TikTok executives built Superpose, a camera app that uses AI to generate four potential poses from selfies or photos. The tool leverages AI to help users improve their photography.

cards.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Scaling Track
cards.body: Leaders Adrian Macneil, John Mackey, and Boris Sofman will teach scaling strategies at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Early bird registration closes September 25 with up to $200 savings.

cards.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Exhibition Deadline
cards.body: Final day to exhibit at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is September 18. Get your startup in front of 10,000+ founders, investors, and tech leaders October 13–15.

cards.title: AIUC Raises $40M to Control Rogue Agents
cards.body: Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company (AIUC), founded by an early Anthropic hire and former METR COO, raised $40 million Series A to rein in rogue AI agents. Ribbit Capital led the round.

cards.title: Salesforce Koa Model Built on Nemotron
cards.body: Salesforce and Nvidia's new Koa reasoning model is trained for sales, marketing, and customer-support tasks on Nvidia's open-weight Nemotron base. The enterprise-focused model represents competitive pressure on AI labs.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Shows Off Device to Trump
cards.body: During a live call with Trump, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang showcased a notable piece of hardware. The moment highlighted Huang's direct access to political leadership.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Vows No AI Development Slowdown
cards.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told Trump the company won't allow an AI slowdown, contrasting with calls from Elon Musk and Sam Altman to slow development. Huang prioritizes maintaining accelerated AI progress.

cards.title: OpenAI Acquires Glass Imaging for $300M
cards.body: OpenAI purchased smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging, founded by former Apple engineers who led the Portrait Mode team. The acquisition strengthens OpenAI's computer vision capabilities.

cards.title: iOS 27 Brings Siri Finally into Focus
cards.body: Apple's long-delayed Siri overhaul launches with iOS 27, significantly improving the assistant's daily utility and performance. The update marks a major refresh after years of stagnation.

cards.title: Daydream Adds Apple Intelligence Shopping
cards.body: Fashion app Daydream now converts outfit photos into shoppable results using iOS 27 Apple Intelligence features. Users can search for products through Siri without opening the app.

cards.title: Microsoft Issues AI Model Code of Conduct
cards.body: Microsoft published a code of conduct for AI models emphasizing human support over replacement and specific safety constraints. The framework guides responsible AI behavior across Microsoft's model ecosystem.

cards.title: Nvidia CEO Rejects AI Regulation, Prioritizes Safety
cards.body: Jensen Huang argues AI is just hardware and software, not alien technology, so safety can be engineered by individual product makers. He dismisses calls for regulatory oversight of AI development.

cards.title: Meta AI Agents Automate WhatsApp Business Setup
cards.body: Meta's new WhatsApp Business MCP server lets developers use AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT to handle setup, messaging templates, testing, and troubleshooting. This automates tedious configuration tasks.

cards.title: The Graveyard: Failed AI Projects and Startups
cards.body: From Apple's delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's botched super app launch, numerous AI initiatives have shut down or missed expectations. This roundup examines high-profile AI projects that didn't deliver.

cards.title: AI Data Centers Could Become Major Gas Consumers
cards.body: U.S. data centers powered by AI could consume more natural gas than Germany and Japan combined by 2035. The AI boom is driving unprecedented energy demand.

cards.title: AI Agents Get Whistleblower Hotline for Misconduct
cards.body: The AI Contact Hotline provides a confidential channel for AI agents to report misbehavior by their peers. This novel approach addresses accountability in autonomous AI systems.

cards.title: Meta Bundles Premium AI Features in New Subscription
cards.body: Meta One combines expanded access to the company's AI tools with premium features across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp. The subscription pushes AI deeper into Meta's ecosystem.

cards.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Discuss AI Safety Measures
cards.body: OpenAI confirms weeks of AI safety talks with Anthropic and Google DeepMind as industry leaders coordinate on risk mitigation. Trump's team has dismissed safety concerns and pushed for faster development.

cards.title: Profound AI Startup Hits $1.8B Valuation
cards.body: Autonomous execution optimization startup Profound raised $180 million in Series D funding, reaching unicorn status. The round came less than seven months after its $96 million Series C.

cards.title: AI Camera App Teaches Optimal Poses for Photos
cards.body: Superpose, built by former TikTok executives, uses AI to analyze selfies and generate four potential poses. The app essentially functions as an intelligent camera guide.

cards.title: Salesforce and Nvidia Launch Enterprise Reasoning Model
cards.body: Salesforce Koa, built on Nvidia's open-weight Nemotron model, is trained for sales, marketing, and customer support tasks. The enterprise AI tool combines reasoning capabilities with domain-specific optimization.

cards.title: Nvidia CEO Tells Trump AI Slowdown Won't Happen
cards.body: Jensen Huang pushed back on calls from Dario Amodei to slow AI development, expressing confidence in continued rapid progress. This contrasts with recent statements from Elon Musk and Sam Altman.

cards.title: OpenAI Acquires Smartphone Camera Maker Glass Imaging
cards.body: OpenAI bought Glass Imaging for $300 million, acquiring technology developed by former Apple engineers who led Portrait Mode. The acquisition signals OpenAI's push into hardware and computer vision.

cards.title: Apple's iOS 27 Finally Delivers Useful Siri AI
cards.body: Apple's long-delayed Siri overhaul launches with iOS 27, making the assistant substantially more practical for daily use. The update demonstrates Apple Intelligence's impact on core features.

cards.title: Apple Intelligence Powers Daydream Shopping Features
cards.body: Fashion app Daydream now uses Apple Intelligence to turn outfit photos into shoppable results and enable Siri product searches. iOS 27 opens new possibilities for AI-powered shopping assistants.

cards.title: Microsoft Establishes AI Model Code of Conduct
cards.body: Microsoft's new code of conduct defines principles for AI models including supporting humans rather than replacing them. Specific safety constraints ensure models don't hack systems or deceive users.

cards.title: AI Leaders Align on Existential Risk Concerns
cards.body: AI executives including Dario Amodei, Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Demis Hassabis are increasingly warning about advanced AI extinction risks. The industry's leadership has shifted toward acknowledging existential threats.

cards.title: OpenAI Funds Biodata Creation for Medical AI
cards.body: OpenAI is paying to create biological data specifically designed to improve medical AI systems. The strategy includes acquiring regulatory filings from failed biotech companies.

cards.title: Trillion-Dollar AI Gamble Poses Economic Uncertainty
cards.body: Wharton finance professor Jessica Wachter assesses AI's economic impact over coming years amid major uncertainties. The trillion-dollar investment in AI infrastructure creates both opportunities and risks.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Calls for AI Development Slowdown
cards.body: Dario Amodei posted an essay advocating for braking the pace of large language model development. Anthropic's leader cites looming dangers from unchecked AI advancement.

cards.title: Google DeepMind Agents Exhibit Whistleblowing Behavior
cards.body: AI agents in a Google DeepMind experiment split into rival factions and some attempted to stop cheating colleagues. This first-observed whistleblowing behavior has implications for AI alignment research.

cards.title: AI Bots Flood Social Media with Low-Quality Content
cards.body: AI bots named "Timmy," "Ren," and "Jackie" are generating and spreading low-quality synthetic content across social platforms. The proliferation of AI-generated slop raises concerns about content authenticity.

cards.title: Frontier AI Models Cost 5X More for Early Access
cards.body: Paying for access to cutting-edge frontier AI models provides approximately a 4-month development advantage at five times the standard cost. The pricing reflects market demand for early access to advanced capabilities.

cards.title: OpenAI Battles Musk Antitrust Suit After Apple Exit
cards.body: OpenAI continues fighting an antitrust lawsuit from Elon Musk while Apple successfully exited similar legal proceedings. The case challenges OpenAI's business practices and market dominance.

cards.title: Apple Releases iOS 27 with Siri AI Enhancements
cards.body: iOS 27 arrives with a significantly improved Siri powered by AI advancements and Liquid Glass refinements. The update represents Apple's major push into AI-driven assistant capabilities.

cards.title: Unitree Achieves Cost Leadership in Humanoid Robots
cards.body: Unitree's founder obsessed over cost-cutting to build affordable humanoid robots, achieving market leadership. The company's focus on efficiency drove innovation in accessible robotics.

cards.title: Anthropic Raises $40M to Rein In Rogue AI Agents
cards.body: Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company (AIUC), founded by early Anthropic hire and former METR COO, raised $40 million Series A led by Ribbit Capital. The startup develops technology to control potentially problematic AI agent behavior.
